fullPassage: Between 1940 and 2000, Cuba ruled the world baseball scene. They won 25 of the first 28 World Cups and 3 of 5 Olympic Games. The Cubans were known for wearing uniforms covered in red from head to toe, a strong contrast to the more conservative North American style featuring grey or white pants. Not only were their athletic talents superior, the Cubans appeared even stronger from just the colour of their uniforms. A game would not even start and the opposing team would already be scared. The country that ruled international baseball for decades has not been on top since that uniform change. Traditions are important for a team; while a team brand or image can adjust to keep up with present times, if it abandons or neglects its roots, negative effects can surface.

det.korean: wear(동사원형) → wearing(동명사): 전치사 for 뒤에는 동명사가 와야 함
det.analysis:
✅ wearing: 'were known for __________'에서 전치사 for의 목적어 자리이므로 동명사 wearing이 필요

'be known for + 동명사' = ~로 유명하다

questions.passage: A few years ago, Cuba altered that uniform style, modernizing it and perhaps __________ (conform) to other countries' style; interestingly, the national team has declined since that time.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: conform(동사원형) → conforming(분사): 앞의 modernizing과 병렬을 이루는 분사구문
det.analysis:
✅ conforming: 'modernizing it and perhaps __________'에서 and로 연결되어 앞의 분사 modernizing과 형태가 같아야 하므로 conforming

두 동작(현대화하며, 순응하며)이 병렬로 연결됨
det.tip: and로 연결된 병렬 → modernizing ... conforming (형태 일치)

questions.passage: Between 1940 and 2000, Cuba ruled the world baseball scene. They won 25 of the first 28 World Cups and 3 of 5 Olympic Games. The Cubans were known for wearing uniforms covered in red from head to toe, __________ to the more conservative North American style featuring grey or white pants. Not only were their athletic talents superior, the Cubans appeared even stronger from just the colour of their uniforms. A game would not even start and the opposing team would already be scared. A few years ago, Cuba altered that uniform style, modernizing it and perhaps conforming to other countries' style; interestingly, the national team has declined since that time. The country that ruled international baseball for decades has not been on top since that uniform change. Traditions are important for a team; while a team brand or image can adjust to keep up with present times, if it abandons or neglects its roots, negative effects can surface.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 머리부터 발끝까지 붉은 쿠바 유니폼은 절제된 북미 스타일과 __________를 이뤘다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① a strong contrast: 강한 대비 — 붉은색 대 회색·흰색의 뚜렷한 차이를 나타냄

❌ ② a close similarity: 밀접한 유사성 — 대비 문맥과 반대

❌ ③ a minor addition: 작은 추가 — 색 대비를 설명하지 못함

❌ ④ a direct copy: 직접적인 복제 — 서로 다른 스타일 대비와 반대
det.tip: a strong contrast to ~ = ~와의 강한 대비

questions.passage: Between 1940 and 2000, Cuba ruled the world baseball scene. They won 25 of the first 28 World Cups and 3 of 5 Olympic Games. The Cubans were known for wearing uniforms covered in red from head to toe, a strong contrast to the more conservative North American style featuring grey or white pants. Not only were their athletic talents superior, the Cubans appeared even stronger from just the colour of their uniforms. A game would not even start and the opposing team would already be scared. A few years ago, Cuba altered that uniform style, modernizing it and perhaps conforming to other countries' style; interestingly, the national team has declined since that time. The country that ruled international baseball for decades has not been on top since that uniform change. Traditions are important for a team; while a team brand or image can adjust to __________, if it abandons or neglects its roots, negative effects can surface.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 팀의 브랜드나 이미지는 __________ 위해 조정될 수 있지만, 뿌리를 버리면 부정적 결과가 생긴다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① ignore modern trends: 현대 흐름을 무시하다 — 조정(adjust)의 목적과 반대

❌ ② reject all changes: 모든 변화를 거부하다 — 조정한다는 문맥과 모순

✅ ③ keep up with present times: 현시대에 발맞추다 — 이미지가 시대에 맞춰 조정된다는 흐름과 일치

❌ ④ return to ancient roots: 옛 뿌리로 돌아가다 — 뒤의 '뿌리를 버리면'과 논리가 어긋남
det.tip: keep up with present times = 현시대에 발맞추다
